newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 5.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - French business leaders in Abidjan to look at Ivory Coast's "promising market". - Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan to give an update on the state of Ivory Coast's economy at a news conference on Wednesday. - Prime Minister Duncan satisfied with construction work at site of Ivory Coast's trade fair opening on Thursday; 557 of 615 stands completed and delivered to exhibitors. LE JOUR - President Henri Konan Bedie's hand strengthened after congress of ruling Democratic Party, which elected him its president. - A total of 500 enterprises confirm their participation at Ivory Coast's 10-day trade fair from Thursday. LA VOIE - Ivory Coast's two leading opposition parties -- Popular Front and Republican Rally -- consolidate alliance. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
